title: leadership-working-session-issues-triage-2026-04-21
content:
Meeting: Cross-team leadership working session — issues triage
Date: 2026-04-21 09:30-10:45 PT
Facilitator: Priya Nambiar
Location: Zoom / #eng-leadership Slack
Attendees: Priya (runtime), Ethan (platform-engineering), Marta (observability), Jamal (sre), Olivia (product-hosted-api), Kiran (release-eng) — listed attendees present and patch-ins noted inline

Agenda:
- Quick metrics snapshot and SLO drift
- Open high-severity items: infra preemptions, model rollout regression (A/B), KV-cache correctness bug
- Prioritization of capacity vs. quality work for next two sprints
- Decide on on-call escalation change for Dedicated pools
- Action items & owners

Quick metrics snapshot (10m):
- 99p latency (text-gen, 2k context) — 230ms -> +12% last 48h (spiky aligns with nightly batch jobs)
- Token throughput per GPU — steady at target for production fleets, but Dedicated pools showing jitter during autoscale events
- Error rate: 0.23% global token errors; 48h spike to 0.9% tied to PR#981 deployment (see linked PR)
- Cost: cost/token increased ~3% after quantization profile rollout on staging; investigating batching config impact

Notes / discussion:
1) Preemptions & autoscale jitter (owner: Ethan)
- Symptom: Dedicated capacity nodes being preempted then reattached leads to temporary cold-cache storms and latency spikes for pinned customers.
- Root cause hypothesis: cloud provider preemption timing + our rebalancer aggressively moving KV state; observed spike at 03:00 UTC recurring when batch jobs reschedule.
- Short-term mitigation: set soft-safety window 10m for rebalancer during known nightly windows; enable staggered restart for pool members (Jamal + Ethan to implement change).
- Long-term: negotiate preemption-notify hook with cloud partner, and add state checkpointing to resume warm KV cache faster. Decision: approve soft-safety window.

2) Model A/B regression (owner: Olivia / Research team contact: Dr. Chen)
- Symptom: Canary A/B for 7B-v3 showed 4% increase in hallucination score on subset of prompts; user-facing alerts triggered by quality-monitoring pipeline.
- Investigation: Regression tied to quantization variant used in the canary (q4_0) — seems to correlate with tokenization boundary handling for long prefixes.
- Interim rollback: revert canary to previous quantization profile for production traffic while research investigates. Action: Olivia to open JIRA-PROJ-4582 to track rollback and follow-up evaluation suite.

3) KV-cache correctness bug (owner: Priya)
- Symptom: rare misalignment of cached prefix causing off-by-one token duplication in multi-turn chat flows for a small subset of models and sequence-lengths.
- Repro steps: see linked sandbox script in PR#981. Repro rate ~1/10k requests in synthetic fuzzing but higher in real traffic for long chats.
- Priority: P1 for Canaries and Dedicated customers; P2 for hosted tier (because fallback to stateless path keeps availability but increases cost).
- Action: Priya to cut hotfix branch, Jamal to coordinate canary rollout to internal squads. Target ship: 2026-04-23 EOD.

4) On-call escalation for Dedicated pools (owner: Jamal)
- Problem: current SLO alert routing sends infra-only oncall for Dedicated incidents; product and SEs are not looped early, causing customer-impact delays.
- Proposal: add a second-tier auto-notify to SE rotation when Dedicated incidents breach impact threshold > x clients or latency > y for 5min.
- Discussion: privacy/ops noise concerns. Decision: implement a throttled notify (one summary message + link) to SE rotation after 3 consecutive alerts within 15m. Jamal to prototype, test in beta team.

5) Prioritization: capacity vs. quality for next two sprints (owner: Leadership)
- Options on table: (A) prioritize capacity (autoscaler stability, preemption resilience) to reduce outages, (B) prioritize quality (fix KV bug, additional regressions tests) to reduce regressions.
- Input: product notes show recent CS tickets rising after hallucination regressions; however outages have higher immediate impact for dedicated pays customers.
- Decision: Split approach for next 2 sprints — 60/40 capacity:quality. Immediate hotfix for KV-cache (P1) gets top band. Longer initiative: autoscaler hardening epic. Priya/Ethan to produce a 6-week roadmap by 2026-04-24.

Unresolved questions / risks (notes-to-self):
- Need a faster signal from quality monitors for new quantization profiles; current eval runs are nightly and too slow for canary-level handling. (Action: Olivia to propose a faster smoke test harness.)
- Are we comfortable shipping stateful checkpointing changes before full regression suite? Risk: new complexity may introduce new class of bugs. Need design doc. (Kiran to schedule architecture review.)

Action items (owner / due):
- Jamal + Ethan: implement rebalancer soft-safety window and staggered restarts; test on staging by 2026-04-23.
- Priya: prepare hotfix branch for KV-cache correctness; coordinate canary rollout and postmortem template; target 2026-04-23 EOD.
- Olivia: open rollback ticket JIRA-PROJ-4582, run reduced quantization evaluation set and propose smoke tests by 2026-04-24.
- Priya + Ethan: deliver 6-week roadmap (autoscaler + preemption resilience) by 2026-04-24.
- Jamal: prototype throttled SE notification for Dedicated incidents; demo for leadership 2026-04-29.
- Kiran: schedule architecture review for checkpointing design, invite research and SRE; deliver agenda and initial notes by 2026-04-28.

Follow-ups and dependencies:
- Research (Dr. Chen) to provide deeper analysis of q4_0 behavior on long-prefix tokenization — link to Confluence-Page-6234 for details.
- Release engineering to hold a freeze window while KV-cache hotfix is canaried; coordinate with customer success for communication plan.

Parking lot / low-priority items (for future):
- Explore model shard-level caching for lower cold-start cost (in backlog).
- Revisit cost/token delta after quantization + batching adjustments (owners: product & cost analytics).

Meeting retrospective notes (quick):
- Good cross-team clarity on immediate fixes; need faster quality-to-decision feedback loop (faster evals, smaller smoke sets).
- Keep action owners tight and commit to clear due dates — helps trenches when incidents hit.

Raw chat snippets saved from meeting (informal, may include shorthand):
- "if we can gate the rebalancer during known batch windows we buy a lot of stability — cheap win" — Ethan
- "hotfix must be ship-first, optimize later — less customer noise" — Priya
- "we need guardrails around quantization experiments; canary is a must but smaller cohorts" — Olivia

Next meeting: leadership triage check-in — 2026-04-23 09:00 PT (fast 30m standup) to confirm hotfix rollout and rebalancer change outcome.

Document history / edits: created 2026-04-21 by Priya Nambiar; edited 2026-04-22 with clarified owners and due dates.

End of notes.
